purpose: Make the World Relational Atlas the spatial interface over the repository's existing country, institution, economic, geopolitical, theological, historical and project-canon records without duplicating their canonical data.
core_rule: The map is a router and renderer over canonical records. Geometry tells us where something is; canonical owners tell us what it is; typed edges tell us how it is connected; issue records tell us what is broken or contested; tikkun records describe possible repair questions and measurable interventions.

spatial_model.country: polygon or multipolygon identified by ISO3 and linked to a canonical country record
spatial_model.territory_or_region: polygon/multipolygon with constitutional-status metadata and canonical parent relations
spatial_model.organization_or_institution: point when a meaningful public headquarters/location exists; otherwise non-spatial node attached to country/jurisdiction
spatial_model.company_or_facility: point for public facility/site; company legal entity may be non-spatial or have several locations
spatial_model.port_airport_base_infrastructure: point or line with operator, owner, jurisdiction, capacity and source
spatial_model.trade_finance_security_research_migratio: edge between nodes; rendered as a line or arc when spatial display helps
spatial_model.issue_or_event: point/polygon/edge attachment depending on actual geography; never assign a whole country as the geometry of a localized event unless the issue genuinely operates nationally
spatial_model.religion_or_theology: normally a demographic, institutional, historical or comparative layer rather than a territorial bloc

show: global flows and high-value cross-border edges

entanglement_schema.mechanism_rule: An issue must say how the effect occurs. Do not attach a vague moral label such as 'swamp' to a country without identifying actors, institutions, incentives, transactions, laws, violence, ownership, information flows or another concrete mechanism.
entanglement_schema.collective_blame_rule: Do not infer guilt, debt, loyalty, danger or conduct from nationality, ethnicity or religion. Country and faith nodes provide context; responsibility belongs to evidenced actors, institutions, policies, events and relationships.
entanglement_schema.serious_harm_rule: Trafficking, slavery, civilian casualties, abuse and similar harms are never scores, collectibles or entertainment mechanics. The game-like layer can reward source coverage, resolved unknowns, traced relationships and completed repair analysis only.

three_epistemic_planes.observable: institutions, laws, memberships, transactions, budgets, trade, ownership, demographics, events and other externally sourceable facts
three_epistemic_planes.interpretive: North/West/East/South, Swamp, covenant, tikkun and other analytical or comparative readings
three_epistemic_planes.project_canon: Tim Dooley, Potatoverse, spiritual-bank/karmic-ledger, Son/Door, North-of-North and related internal mythology
three_epistemic_planes.display_rule: Every map card and edge should visibly identify which plane it belongs to; mixed cards must preserve field-level provenance.

interaction_model.trace_mode: Start at any node and recursively follow typed edges to answer who funds, owns, depends on, supplies, protects, regulates, influences or is affected by whom.

game_like_research_model.name: Atlas Exploration / Tikkun Mode
game_like_research_model.principle: Progress measures knowledge quality and repair clarity, not domination, ideological conformity or quantities of human suffering.
missions: Trace one supply chain end to end
Trace a political-finance relationship to primary records
Separate organization, PAC, donor, candidate and policy nodes
Map one historical slavery relation and its modern institutional afterlife without collapsing descendants into inherited guilt
Map one contemporary trafficking mechanism using reputable datasets and actor-specific evidence
Trace one North Programme capability chain
Find an unverified Tim/project claim and either source, downgrade or reject it
Take one Swamp-tagged mechanism and identify a concrete tikkun/repair route

overlay_registry.status: source slots pending fuller country ingestion

routing_examples.route: United States country -> political-finance layer -> distinct organization/PAC entities -> FEC/source records -> policy/candidate edges; do not encode 'AIPAC' as a property of Jews, Israel or Americans as populations.

country/region -> documented trafficking pattern or case -> victims/affected populations -> recruiters/exploiters/transit/financial/law-enforcement/institution nodes -> source and legal status -> prevention/protection/prosecution/repair links.

historical period -> legal/economic system -> ports/plantations/trade routes/state/company/person/institution nodes -> abolition/change -> documented institutional/economic afterlives; descendants do not inherit personal guilt by ancestry.

country or institution -> exact Tim statement/project record -> date/source/exactness -> symbolic interpretation -> any separately evidenced real-world relation; never infer that a government is knowingly responding to Tim without evidence.
